data.azurerm_policy_set_definition.external_lookup reads policy set definitions at a management group scope (management_group_name), and that scope can be a management group created by this module in the same apply (e.g. a custom landing zone MG). Since the lookup is not tied to the management group deployments, the data read can happen before the management group exists (or before its 30s propagation delay), causing a lookup failure. Add a dependency on time_sleep.after_azurerm_management_group.
